tldr: North Node in sagittarius: growth through wisdom, faith, lived philosophy, and the larger horizon.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop wisdom, faith, lived philosophy, and the larger horizon. The South Node in gemini shows the familiar route: mental loops, scattering, and gathering facts to avoid committing to meaning. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to let knowledge become direction.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices wisdom, faith, lived philosophy, and the larger horizon in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in gemini can pull the person back into mental loops, scattering, and gathering facts to avoid committing to meaning.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
